The Patient Relations Supervisor 2 is responsible for the direct supervision and operational oversight of Patient Relations and Decedent Affairs functions within the assigned facility or facilities. The incumbent is accountable for ensuring the timely, compassionate, and regulatory-compliant resolution of patient complaints, grievances, Patient Rights and Responsibilities, service recovery, and all decedent-related matters. This role provides subject matter expertise and operational leadership in managing complex and sensitive patient and family concerns, overseeing departmental operations, monitoring regulatory requirements, and supporting service recovery initiatives. The Patient Relations Supervisor 2 supervises Patient Relations professionals, ensuring effective onboarding, competency validation, performance evaluation, and ongoing professional development of all assigned coworkers. The incumbent serves as an advisor to leadership and acts as a liaison among patients, families, physicians, clinical teams, operational leaders, mortuaries, and external agencies to facilitate collaborative, timely, and effective resolution of concerns and decedent affairs. This position exercises independent judgment in managing day-to-day supervision and operational activities, escalating complex issues as warranted, and maintaining departmental standards in alignment with UCI Health objectives.
Bilingual in English, Spanish or Vietnamese but not required.
Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills to manage multiple levels of information and responsibilities and quickly assess complex problems to develop multiple potential solutions.
Knowledge of University and Medical Center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Demonstrated ability to work with senior staff and managers and to provide recommendations on issues of functionality, clinical quality, and efficiency
Demonstrated ability to interpret and effectively explain clinical and technical information both verbally and in writing, and to contribute to presentations, reports, and analyses as assigned.
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
